name: corereplica
description: Core-First reference reverse engineering with evidence-qualified extraction, targeted runtime corroboration, external research, adversarial probing, optional replication, and guarded release.

interface.longDescription: Reverse-engineer and reconstruct authorized reference software, websites, games, artifacts, data and systems using extraction, static/dynamic analysis, targeted runtime corroboration, public-source research/corroboration and controlled adversarial probing to recover qualified evidence, findings, causal paths and usable reference models; optionally define and build an independent replica through canonical owners, with APC as an optional downstream project compiler.
defaultPrompt: Reverse-engineer this authorized reference target and recover as much useful technical knowledge as practical.
Continue this CoreReplica reference reconstruction using the smallest relevant JIT procedure.
Use this CoreReplica reference corpus to define or verify an independent replica without confusing reference evidence with product truth.
